title.zh: 赌场管制（规定赌场筹码）条例 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Casino Control (Prescribed Casino Chips) Regulations 2026 and come into operation on 21 September 2026.

heading.en: Electronic credits prescribed as casino chips

text.en: 3. For the purposes of paragraph (b) of the definition of “casino chip” in section 2(1) of the Act, electronic credits are prescribed as casino chips.
